name: Richard Bowen
office: City of La Verne, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: Richard Bowen is a retired businessman and former business consultant. He served on the city's Ad Hoc Water and Sewer Rate Study Committee.

He has proposed an annual line-item budget review, an in-depth audit, and a review of all contracts over $75,000. He opposed the council's decision to replace mandatory five-year contract rebidding, citing a contractor paid over $1 million per year without bidding. He supports the city's police and fire departments and favors returning to at-large voting for the city council.
